P2-C3 · proposal for Owner approval · 2026-09-29

MyTask design system preview

One page with every token and component, plus four screens shown old (live site today) next to new. The rule is modernise, don't reinvent: the new screens keep the live structure, flows and placement. Only the look, spacing, consistency, accessibility and mobile behaviour change.

How to review. Use the switches at the top: Theme (Light is the default, Dark, System) and Text language (Georgian first, English). Both are remembered in this browser. Press Tab to see focus rings. Resize the window down to a phone (360 px) to check mobile. Component texts are Georgian first; the notes for you (like this one) stay in English.
  • Owner decisions shown here: Q-059 light default + dark mode, Q-093 System option, Q-073 dark teal buttons, Q-078 no sky blue, Q-091 orange Premium "Featured" frame and badge, Q-092 Buying = blue and Selling = green, Q-094 desktop header 72 px, Q-014 no levels, Q-062 two rating blocks, P-46 no quantity selector on the gig page, Q-090 the "M" mark, Q-081 Premium bought by card.
  • Sources: packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css (linked live), docs/05-design/tokens.md, components.md, audit.md, approved specs 00–14, live-site texts fetched read-only on 2026-09-29.
  • Icons are real Phosphor v2 glyphs (MIT), inlined as SVG so the page needs no internet.

1. Theme, language and Georgian rendering

FiraGO is the only font (real weights 400/500/600/700, full Mkhedruli, ₾). No uppercase on Georgian: FiraGO has no Mtavruli glyphs, so uppercase would fall back to another font.

2. Tokens

Every value below is read live from packages/tokens/dist/tokens.css. If a token changes and build.mjs is re-run, this page updates by itself.

2.1 Colour scales (primitives)

Apps never use these directly; they use the semantic roles in 2.2. Shown so you can see where each role comes from.

2.2 Semantic roles, light and dark

Components use only these names. Each role has a light and a dark value; switching the theme swaps them all at once.

Light (default)

Dark

2.3 Contrast ratios (WCAG 2.1 AA)

Every foreground/background pair the system defines, in both themes. Text needs 4.5:1, UI parts (borders, focus ring, stars, dots) need 3:1. We never rely on the large-text exception.

2.4 Type scale

9 sizes, minimum 13 px, body 16/24, inputs 16 (no iOS zoom). Headings step up from 1024 px. The last value shows what your browser computed right now.

2.5 Spacing (4 px grid)

2.6 Radii

One radius per role: controls 8, cards 12, dialogs and sheets 16, hero tiles 24, pills full. Legacy had 4 different button shapes.

2.7 Elevation (shadows)

Three levels. Dark mode uses stronger shadows and keeps card borders, because dark surfaces hide shadows.

sm · resting card
md · hover, menu
lg · dialog, toast

2.8 Focus ring

2 px ring, 2 px offset, brand.600 in light and brand.300 in dark, at least 3:1 on every surface. It shows only for keyboard focus (:focus-visible). The samples below are frozen in the focused state; press Tab anywhere to see the real one.

2.10 Motion

fast 120 (hover, focus) · base 200 (menus, tabs, toasts) · slow 300 (dialogs, sheets) · slower 400. With the operating system's "reduce motion" setting, every duration becomes 0 and slides turn into fades.

3. Components

Every component in components.md, with variants and states. States that need a mouse or keyboard (hover, focus-visible, pressed) are also shown frozen, labelled under each sample. Interactive ones really work: try the keyboard.

Phosphor Regular for default, Fill for active/selected. Icons inherit the text colour and never carry meaning alone.

3.2 Button

One radius (8), three sizes (36 dense desktop / 44 default / 52 CTA), six variants. Labels wrap to two lines instead of being cut (Georgian is 20–40 % longer). Minimum width 88 px. Disabled stays readable (≥ 4.5:1). Loading keeps the label so the width does not jump.

3.17 Dialog, ConfirmDialog, BottomSheet, Toast

One modal system (legacy had four, none with dialog semantics or a focus trap). Tab stays inside, Esc closes, focus returns to the button you used. On phones (under 768 px) dialogs become bottom sheets automatically; the "as bottom sheet" button forces it on desktop so you can see it. Toasts: top-centre on desktop, bottom on phones; they pause on hover or focus.

4. Old vs new: four key screens

Old is a faithful, simplified rendering of the live site built from the audit and the live HTML (read-only, 2026-09-29): real texts, real legacy colours, sizes and problems (faux bold, uppercase Georgian falling back to another font, 32 px targets, 9 px labels, sky-blue banner, fixed 600 px hero, the 400 px switcher). I did not use screenshots because they would contain real users' photos and names; category artwork stands in for gig images on both sides. New uses tokens and components only, with the same structure and placement.

Each pair can be shown side by side, at desktop width (stacked, each frame full width) or at phone width (360 px). Frames respond to their own width, so every mode shows the real responsive layout. The dashboard is Blade-only (needs login), so its "old" side comes from the Blade templates.

4.1 Home

Kept: transparent header over the teal hero, the hero h1 + search + invite banner + Gigs/Projects shortcuts, then Featured categories, Projects, Top gigs rows with "See more". Changed: 72 px header with the logo sized by its real height; orange promo banner instead of sky blue; shortcuts stay visible on phones as two buttons; hero is min 360 px on phones (legacy fixed 600); one section-title style; "See more" on every size; quiet "No reviews yet"; en dash in budget ranges.
